description: This file defines the EditNotebookDialog class, a UI component for editing or creating notebooks within an Android application. It manages dialog interactions, input validation, and communicates with a ViewModel to persist changes.

classes.name: EditNotebookDialog
classes.description: A dialog class for editing or creating notebooks, extending BaseDialog with a specific binding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, retrieving the Notebook object from arguments.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Creates and returns the view binding for the dialog.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures the dialog UI based on whether a notebook is being edited or created, setting up button actions and input fields.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the dialog with an optional Notebook argument.
